mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales below their 6-month moving averages indicate broad-based demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 6-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below its 3-month moving average during early economic contraction signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 3-month moving average during early economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1,600,000 units annually signal strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1,600,000 units annually.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.3% signals rising inflation that may trigger Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market strengthening, a monthly employment increase exceeding 100,000 persons predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 100,000 persons during labor market strengthening.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in quarterly GDP growth below 0.5% annualized and monthly housing starts decline exceeding 0.5% indicate economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized and HOUST declines > 0.5% monthly
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is below 0.5% annualized and HOUST declines > 0.5% monthly.
